scope: Read-only source pairing only, no additional tests or device playback

connections.name: call_boundary
connections.finding: Published LumoHost exports speakLearning/getLearningSpeechStatus/stopLearningSpeech; Activity delegates to actual Speech.speak/status/stop. Native uses those exact methods.

connections.name: ownership
connections.finding: Native increments its utterance id on stop and speaks with its next id. It consumes only a matching id and recognized state. Host snapshot carries that utterance and reports preparing separately from actual playing.

connections.name: actual_sample
connections.finding: Native permits teacher-speaking only for state playing plus audible true. Jaw sampling additionally requires envelopeAvailable true and passes positionMs/1000 plus measured envelope to Actor. Host uses actual MediaPlayer.isPlaying/currentPosition and stream mute/volume with existing consent/activity gates.

connections.name: lifecycle
connections.finding: Native stop resets both speaking and sampled amplitude; suspension and reduced motion reset facial pose and suppress articulation. Host Activity activates/resumes, deactivates/pauses, destroys, and stops before actual return. Pending synthesis/envelope generation is cancelled and generation checked.

connections.name: build_preserved
connections.finding: All three current launch/Activity boundaries still carry learning and build. Merged Speech retains exactly that allow-list and its existing voice/license/rate/offline semantics. Native facial learning-world does not require broadening any other scene.

limits: Neither Host nor Native packet is a fresh combined runtime or Android playback result.
PCM is bounded amplitude for a closed muzzle; no phoneme, viseme or lip-sync claim.
The current unchanged 7b16 APK remains tied to Native17f5 and does not contain this candidate.
